description: Orchestrator Agent hooks - task completion enforcement, verification, polling
_note: Hook data is passed via stdin as JSON. Scripts read from stdin, not env vars.

Stop._description: Blocks premature exit until all tasks are complete

PreToolUse._description: MANDATORY: Blocks agent work reports if instruction verification incomplete
PreToolUse._matcher_note: ANCHORED ON PURPOSE. The subagent tool is named Agent on current Claude Code and Task on older builds, so this gate must match both or it silently never fires. It must NOT be written as bare 'Task|Agent': matchers are regex, and unanchored 'Agent' also matches ListAgents, which would fire this MANDATORY gate on every peer-discovery call.

UserPromptSubmit._description: MANDATORY: Reminds orchestrator when progress polling is overdue

PostToolUse._description: Track file modifications for orchestration context
PostToolUse._matcher_note: MultiEdit was removed from Claude Code, so its alternation branch was dead. Anchored so a longer future tool name containing 'Edit' or 'Write' cannot match by accident.
